0022600229.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, 2nd in the Northwest, 1 game back) host the Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West) on a three-game winning streak, with Minnesota 3-1 at home this season. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery; averaging 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes this season) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). Minnesota won the last meeting 124-94 in Dallas on March 30, and it swept the four games in the 2025-26 season series, with no games yet in 2026-27.
